title: RenderConsistencyContract
description: Deterministic render contract for animated sequences and shots (inspired by heygen/hyperframes).

reference_sequence.description: Path to reference greybox or previs sequence

max_drift_px.description: Maximum allowed spatial anchor point drift in pixels (e.g. 5.0)

max_luma_variance.description: Maximum allowed luminance delta across adjacent frames (0.0 to 1.0)

max_flicker_ratio.description: Maximum optical variance ratio allowed before gate triggers FLAGGED/REJECT

color_palette_lock.description: Strict enforcement of character wardrobe and environment color continuity
